approved: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
This bill would authorise spending from the Consolidated Revenue Fund for the Parliamentary Departments.
It would provide about seven-twelfths of the estimated annual funding for 2025-26, plus new budget measures.
A separate supply bill covers the remaining five-twelfths to fund the first five months of the financial year.
